items.title: Treat deep water as lethal
items.description: Claude cannot swim in the original game; approach docks and boat transfers carefully.

description_i18n.en: Claude cannot swim in the original game; approach docks and boat transfers carefully.

items.details: Claude cannot swim in the original PS2 game. Deep water is not an escape route from police, and a vehicle entering it can end an otherwise successful mission. Slow down near the docks and keep room to turn a car around. For boat transfers, bring the hull alongside a low landing before stepping out; do not jump toward a distant shore. Save before unfamiliar water missions so a failed transfer does not cost a long stretch of unsaved progress.

details_i18n.en: Claude cannot swim in the original PS2 game. Deep water is not an escape route from police, and a vehicle entering it can end an otherwise successful mission. Slow down near the docks and keep room to turn a car around. For boat transfers, bring the hull alongside a low landing before stepping out; do not jump toward a distant shore. Save before unfamiliar water missions so a failed transfer does not cost a long stretch of unsaved progress.
details_i18n.pt: Claude não sabe nadar no jogo original de PS2. Águas profundas não servem como rota de fuga da polícia, e um veículo que caia nelas pode encerrar uma missão quase concluída. Reduza perto dos cais e deixe espaço para manobrar o carro. Ao sair de um barco, encoste o casco ao lado de um desembarque baixo antes de descer; não salte na direção de uma margem distante. Salve antes de missões aquáticas desconhecidas para evitar perder um longo trecho de progresso.

items.details: For a 100% run, use a separate save before the three major availability changes. Finish Luigi and Joey before Salvatore's Last Requests; following the full Toni strand first is also the safe Portland route. Finish all five Kenji assignments before Donald's Waka-Gashira Wipeout!, and finish Asuka's Two-Faced Tanner before Grand Theft Aero. The optional contact category lists these ten permanently missable jobs separately. A later safehouse save does not restore a lost contact; an earlier save is the straightforward recovery.

details_i18n.en: For a 100% run, use a separate save before the three major availability changes. Finish Luigi and Joey before Salvatore's Last Requests; following the full Toni strand first is also the safe Portland route. Finish all five Kenji assignments before Donald's Waka-Gashira Wipeout!, and finish Asuka's Two-Faced Tanner before Grand Theft Aero. The optional contact category lists these ten permanently missable jobs separately. A later safehouse save does not restore a lost contact; an earlier save is the straightforward recovery.
details_i18n.pt: Para buscar 100%, mantenha um salvamento separado antes das três grandes mudanças de disponibilidade. Termine Luigi e Joey antes de Last Requests, de Salvatore; concluir primeiro a sequência de Toni também é a rota segura de Portland. Termine os cinco trabalhos de Kenji antes de Waka-Gashira Wipeout!, de Donald, e Two-Faced Tanner, de Asuka, antes de Grand Theft Aero. A categoria de contatos opcionais lista separadamente esses dez trabalhos perdíveis. Um salvamento posterior não restaura um contato perdido; recuperar um salvamento anterior é a solução direta.

items.details: Bring the requested funds to 8-Ball, take him to the harbor and climb the warehouse roof facing the ship before firing. Your first shot starts his advance, so identify the guards before beginning. Clear the two guards near the boarding approach, then quickly work along the deck so nobody can shoot him as he moves forward. Prioritize enemies with a clear line to 8-Ball rather than distant targets. Keep the sniper view controlled and avoid explosions close to him. If he dies, the mission fails even if you survive.

details_i18n.en: Bring the requested funds to 8-Ball, take him to the harbor and climb the warehouse roof facing the ship before firing. Your first shot starts his advance, so identify the guards before beginning. Clear the two guards near the boarding approach, then quickly work along the deck so nobody can shoot him as he moves forward. Prioritize enemies with a clear line to 8-Ball rather than distant targets. Keep the sniper view controlled and avoid explosions close to him. If he dies, the mission fails even if you survive.
details_i18n.pt: Leve o dinheiro solicitado a 8-Ball, acompanhe-o ao porto e suba ao teto do armazém de frente para o navio antes de disparar. Seu primeiro tiro inicia o avanço dele, portanto identifique os guardas antes de começar. Elimine os dois próximos do acesso ao navio e avance rapidamente pela tripulação no convés, impedindo que atirem nele. Priorize inimigos com visão direta de 8-Ball em vez de alvos distantes. Controle a mira do rifle e evite explosões perto dele. Se ele morrer, a missão falha mesmo que você sobreviva.

items.details: If pursuing 100%, finish the remaining Luigi and Joey jobs before starting this departure. Approach the indicated car area and pay attention to Maria's pager message: the original instruction is superseded. Do not enter the trapped vehicle. Follow the new meeting marker by the waterfront instead, then take the boat with Maria and Asuka to the indicated landing. Afterward establish a new save at the Staunton hideout. details_i18n.pt: Se buscar 100%, termine os trabalhos restantes de Luigi e Joey antes de iniciar esta partida. Aproxime-se da área do carro indicado e preste atenção à mensagem de Maria no pager: ela substitui a instrução original. Não entre no veículo preparado como armadilha. Siga a nova marcação de encontro à beira da água e leve Maria e Asuka de barco ao desembarque indicado. Depois, faça um novo salvamento no esconderijo de Staunton. items.details: Completing Sayonara Salvatore makes the Mafia hostile and equips its street members with especially dangerous close-range firepower. Portland activities remain available, but an ambulance, race car or delivery van can be destroyed very quickly when passing Mafia territory. For an easier 100% route, finish Paramedic and El Burro's Portland jobs early, preferably before other gang hostility has escalated as well. This is a difficulty warning, distinct from Luigi and Joey's permanent Last Requests lockout.

details_i18n.pt: Concluir Sayonara Salvatore torna a Máfia hostil e dá aos integrantes nas ruas um poder de fogo especialmente perigoso de perto. As atividades de Portland continuam disponíveis, mas uma ambulância, carro de corrida ou furgão pode ser destruído rapidamente ao atravessar o território da Máfia. Para uma rota de 100% mais fácil, conclua Paramedic e os trabalhos de El Burro cedo, de preferência antes de aumentar também a hostilidade de outras gangues. Este é um aviso de dificuldade, diferente do bloqueio permanente de Luigi e Joey em Last Requests.

items.details: The marked groups are not all at street level. Prepare a sniper rifle before starting so the higher targets are reachable. Clear the accessible groups, then use the Kenji casino building's stairs to gain a view of the surveillance team on the opposite rooftop. Do not waste the timer driving around the same ground-level marker looking for a doorway directly beneath the targets. Identify the full group before leaving each position and check the remaining markers.

details_i18n.pt: Os grupos marcados não estão todos no nível da rua. Prepare um rifle de precisão antes de começar para alcançar os alvos mais altos. Resolva os grupos acessíveis e use as escadas do cassino de Kenji para obter visão da equipe de vigilância na cobertura oposta. Não desperdice o cronômetro circulando pela marcação no chão à procura de uma porta logo abaixo dos alvos. Identifique o grupo inteiro antes de sair de cada posição e confira as marcações restantes.

items.details: This transfer becomes available after both Plaster Blaster and A Drop In The Ocean. The main bridge approach is watched by shooters, so use the Porter Tunnel connection to Shoreside Vale rather than following the most obvious road across. Keep a sound vehicle and head for the airport marker within the timer. After dropping Ray off, follow his message to the garage reward. Finish that follow-up before abandoning the chain; reaching the airport is not the only useful part of this assignment.

details_i18n.pt: Esta transferência fica disponível após Plaster Blaster e A Drop In The Ocean. O acesso pela ponte principal é vigiado por atiradores, então use a conexão do Porter Tunnel com Shoreside Vale em vez de seguir a travessia mais óbvia. items.details: Collect the supplied Rocket Launcher before taking the boat to the marked airport approach. Reach the interception point while the flight countdown is still running, then line up the plane as it approaches rather than chasing it after landing. Dock at the marked access ramp and move onto dry land before aiming the Rocket Launcher; falling into the water is lethal. After the hit, recover every marked package, including any that landed on the runway, and leave with the cargo. Return to the construction-site objective despite the wanted level; destroying the plane alone does not complete the mission.

items.details: Paramedic requires a single uninterrupted run from level one through twelve; separate shorter attempts do not combine into level twelve. The ambulance carries three patients at once, so group pickups into sensible trips back to the hospital. Brake early near patients and hospital doors: running over a patient ends the attempt, and collisions waste precious time. Protect the ambulance from rolling over and do not get out or switch vehicles. An early Portland attempt is usually simpler before surrounding gangs become hostile. Save before starting and after a successful finish.

details_i18n.en: Paramedic requires a single uninterrupted run from level one through twelve; separate shorter attempts do not combine into level twelve. Brake early near patients and hospital doors: running over a patient ends the attempt, and collisions waste precious time. Protect the ambulance from rolling over and do not get out or switch vehicles. An early Portland attempt is usually simpler before surrounding gangs become hostile. Save before starting and after a successful finish.
details_i18n.pt: Paramedic exige uma única tentativa contínua do nível um ao doze; tentativas curtas separadas não se somam para atingir o nível doze. A ambulância leva três pacientes por vez, então agrupe as buscas em viagens sensatas ao hospital. Freie cedo perto dos pacientes e das entradas: atropelar um paciente encerra a tentativa, e colisões desperdiçam tempo precioso. Evite capotar a ambulância e não desça nem troque de veículo. Uma tentativa inicial em Portland costuma ser mais simples antes da hostilidade das gangues próximas. Salve antes de começar e depois de concluir com sucesso.

items.details: There are two normal sixteen-model lists, at Portland Docks and the Shoreside garage, plus a separate seven-model emergency crane in Portland. The crane needs Police, Ambulance, Fire Truck, Barracks OL, FBI Car, Enforcer and Rhino. Read each normal list at its own door and use the crossed-off entries to track deliveries. Portland's normal list includes the Dodo, so an early visit cannot finish everything before the airport becomes accessible. The Rhino can be obtained after the finale at Phil's compound, avoiding a forced six-star theft. None of the lists requires online access.

Portland's normal list includes the Dodo, so an early visit cannot finish everything before the airport becomes accessible. details_i18n.pt: Existem duas listas comuns de dezesseis modelos, em Portland Docks e na garagem de Shoreside, além de um guindaste separado de sete modelos de emergência em Portland. O guindaste exige Police, Ambulance, Fire Truck, Barracks OL, FBI Car, Enforcer e Rhino. Leia cada lista comum na própria porta e acompanhe os itens riscados para registrar entregas. A lista comum de Portland inclui o Dodo, portanto uma visita inicial não permite terminar tudo antes de acessar o aeroporto. O Rhino pode ser obtido após o final no pátio de Phil, evitando um roubo obrigatório com seis estrelas. Nenhuma lista exige acesso online.
